t: This is Elgin Crescent, a street in Notting Hill, in the Royal Borough of Kensington and Chelsea. Thomas Howarth, a schoolmaster and historian who lived from 1914 to 1988, lived on this street. It's a pleasing thought that someone who spent his life teaching and writing about the past made his home here. There isn't a great deal more recorded about the street itself, so take your time and enjoy the Notting Hill atmosphere around you.
